title: EvolvAttack: Backdooring self Evolving VLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.15244v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Self-evolving mechanisms let vision-language model (VLM) agents continually adapt through evolving memory, but they also allow malicious behavior to emerge only after deployment. We introduce a new attack surface, the self-evolving backdoor, whose payload stays dormant in the initial agent and is progressively activated as the agent evolves. Unlike conventional backdoors, which can be exposed by testing triggered inputs on a static model, our attack requires both a visual trigger and a sufficiently evolved memory state; static scanning with clean memory thus yields near-zero attack success and may deem the agent benign. We realize this through memory-aware backdoor training, which couples trigger activation with the agent's evolving memory while preserving benign behavior unless the trigger co-occurs with payload-related memory. Across three VLM backbones, four agent pipelines, and recency-, semantic-, and reward-based memory evolution

translated_title: EvolvAttack：对自我进化VLM智能体的后门攻击
translated_abstract: 自我进化机制使视觉-语言模型（VLM）智能体能够通过不断演化的记忆持续适应环境，但这也使恶意行为可能在部署之后才显现出来。我们引入了一种新的攻击面——自我进化后门，其恶意载荷在初始智能体中保持休眠状态，并随着智能体的进化而逐步被激活。与传统的后门攻击不同（传统后门可以通过在静态模型上测试触发输入而被暴露），我们的攻击需要同时具备视觉触发器和充分进化的记忆状态；因此，在干净记忆下进行静态扫描得到的攻击成功率接近于零，可能使该智能体被判定为良性。我们通过记忆感知的后门训练来实现这一攻击，该方法将触发器激活与智能体的进化记忆相耦合，同时保持良性表现，除非触发器与载荷相关的记忆同时出现。该攻击在三个VLM骨干网络、四种智能体流水线，以及基于近期性、语义和奖励的记忆进化机制上均得到验证。
tldr: 提出了一种针对自我进化VLM智能体的新型后门攻击EvolvAttack，其恶意载荷在部署前保持休眠，只有当视觉触发器与充分进化的记忆状态同时存在时才会激活，从而能够逃逸传统的静态安全扫描。
en_tdlr: Proposes EvolvAttack, a novel self-evolving backdoor attack on VLM agents whose payload remains dormant until activated by the co-occurrence of a visual trigger and a sufficiently evolved memory state, thereby evading static security scanning.
